content.text:
**MFN — Compliant (preferred position).**

No most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Sanofi exists anywhere in the Agreement. I ran keyword and regex sweeps for "most favored/favoured nation", "no less favorable", "at least as favorable", "more favorable", "MFN", "best terms/price", "match", and "right of first negotiation/refusal"; the only "no less" hits are governance meeting-frequency/notice standards (p0225, p0227, p0244) and confidentiality care standards (p0453, p0473) — none is a pricing or terms-comparison mechanic, and there is no disclosure or right-to-match construct that would fall under this rule.

The economics run in our favour: RevMed grants Sanofi an exclusive licence (p0248) and Sanofi controls pricing and reimbursement approvals (§8.4), with no obligation to extend RevMed terms granted to any Third Party. No redline proposed.
